brèche: n.f. 缺口 ； v. 间隙（裂缝，火花隙，通道，放电器） ； v. 破坏（违犯，绝交，破口，堤坝决口）

brève: a brief piece of information or news (as opposed to the headline)
pitta; any bird belonging to the passerine family Pittidae
adj. 有权威的（来源可靠的，当局的，命令式的）
brési: Salted, dried, and smoked beef, originally from the Jura region.
bréviaire: breviary (a book containing prayers and hymns)
n.m. 日课经，祈祷书；身边必备的书，枕边书，必读书
brûlage: n.m. 烧掉野草或荆棘；烧发梢；用火烧旧漆
brûlant: adj. 灼热的，滚烫的；发烫，发烧；热情的，热烈的；最近的，新近的，难对付的，棘手的

to be boiling, to be very close to the answer
烫伤，烧伤，灼伤；晒枯，晒坏；使产生烧伤的感觉，剌激
brûler la chandelle par les deux bouts: /bʁy.le la ʃɑ̃.dɛl paʁ le dø bu/
to burn the candle at both ends (to do things in excess, to engage in too much work or too much pleasure (including spending money), or both)
brûler la politesse: to give someone the slip, to slip away from
brûler les lèvres: to be on someone's lips, to be nagging [with à ‘someone’] (of a question)
brûler les étapes: to jump the gun, to cut corners, to go too fast, to get ahead of oneself
brûler ses vaisseaux: to burn one's boats (to cut oneself off from all chance of retreat in order to commit to a course of action)
brûlerie: n.f. 咖啡豆焙炒装置；蒸馏烧酒装置
brûleur: n.m. 燃烧器，喷嘴，喷火头
brûlis: swidden, woodland exposed to slash and burn

brûlure au premier degré: first-degree burn (mild burn that causes redness of the skin but no blistering)
brûlures d'estomac: heartburn, pyrosis (burning sensation due to reflux)
